title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.24.0 highlights overdue dated TODO comments in red so stale work is easy to spot.

highlights.title: Overdue TODO Highlighting
highlights.description: Dated TODO comments past their due date now render in red, so stale work stands out without scanning every comment by hand.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Dated TODO comments that have passed their due date now render in red, making overdue work visible at a glance instead of requiring a manual scan through the file.
Works in both desktop VS Code and VS Code for the Web.
Can be toggled with the kotlinJump.todoExpiry setting.
